scope: Broad South African consumer competition, reward, sample and offer discovery; worldwide creative contests where official source explicitly indicates worldwide eligibility.

catalogueComparison.source: Remote GitHub main, not stale local checkout
catalogueComparison.method: Compare provider/campaign name, source URL and campaign period against all five registries. ExistingId values checked for existence. This is campaign-level deduplication, not a full audit of published records.

statusDefinitions.shortlist: New source-backed discovery candidate; full eligibility, entry-form, cost, consent, artwork and release checks remain. Not approved for publication.
statusDefinitions.upcoming: New candidate with future start; do not present as currently open.
statusDefinitions.verification-hold: Material evidence gap, conflicting terms, inaccessible current rules or press-only lead. Do not publish.
statusDefinitions.existing-review: Already in an under-review registry; improve existing record rather than duplicate.
statusDefinitions.already-listed: Campaign or benefit already recorded on remote main; do not duplicate.
statusDefinitions.exclude: Expired, no verified SA availability, or unsuitable for a completely-free claim.

limitations: Broad but not exhaustive: search indexes miss app-only, email-only, in-store-only and poorly indexed social campaigns.
No accounts, entries, subscriptions or marketing-consent submissions were created.
No new consumer listings published in this discovery pass.
Artwork acquisition and desktop/mobile QA are required at publication stage under AGENTS.md; no discovery record should be copied straight into production.

Cached search/browser representations sometimes disagreed with direct provider responses. Current direct fetches resolved Mambo’s and 1UP; Pattex remains held because its linked terms are older than its current banner.
The 21 shortlist items are a discovery queue, not 21 fully verified/ready-to-publish offers.
Existing Bella’s Kitchen and Wimpy Kid holds from earlier work remain unchanged.

records.title: Outdoorphoto wishlist: Tenba Axis v2 28L Spinner Backpack
records.cost: No purchase; free account and wishlist
records.findings: 20 Oct–10 Nov. Prize advertised R10,295. Up to five distinct eligible products/entries. Standard giveaway terms still need full eligibility review.

records.title: Gelmar Pass the Parcel: daily R1,000 vouchers
records.findings: 5–30 Oct; one R1,000 voucher each weekday, total R20,000. Facebook/Instagram daily draws; may only win once. Confirm current social post and full eligibility before listing.

records.title: Maynards Kaboom Your Festive / SPAR
records.findings: 12 Oct–26 Dec. R250,000 is the pool: 1,250 R200 digital vouchers. Capture exact products, quantities and card mechanics from schedule before publication.

records.title: Sausage Saloon: MacBook Neo
records.cost: Qualifying Local Wors Feast or Fiesta Deal purchase
records.findings: 1 Oct–15 Dec. One laptop advertised R13,999. Unique receipt per entry, participating outlets, adult declaration; optional marketing. Full rules linked on campaign page.

records.title: Nedbank Black Friday travel-voucher draw
records.findings: 28 Sep–30 Nov. R5 million overall pool, R50,000 Tourvest vouchers per winner. Active Money app and qualifying actions; base entry per R5,000 spend, bonus rules differ. Not a R5 million individual cash prize.

records.title: Turn Up Summer with Samsung and Telkom
records.cost: Qualifying device contract/upgrade and promotional redemption
records.findings: 7 Oct–15 Feb. Cash and TVs across device tiers/phases. Distinct from Telkom Datanaire Tap2Win. Must complete phase-specific prize, entry and promotional redemption review.

records.title: Water Filter Factory October Spring Giveaway
records.findings: 1–31 Oct. Ten replacement filter sets; membranes excluded. Qualifying systems only, no separate entry form; one entry/order, not system. Winners 2 Nov. No standalone free filter entitlement.

records.title: The Bed Centre: Win Your Purchase Back
records.findings: 1–31 Oct. One winner receives product value on qualifying invoice; delivery and returned/refunded items excluded. Each invoice once. Prize is refund, not guaranteed cashback.

records.title: JWD: website worth R10,000
records.cost: No purchase; business representative and required steps
records.findings: 12 Oct–31 Dec. SA adults representing existing or prospective business/organisation. Agreed website scope within R10,000, not cash. Three entry steps; full linked rules and post mechanics need review.

records.title: Bogart Radio / PeaceHaven Love Story getaway
records.findings: Three-night getaway for a couple; 30–90 second love-story Reel, follow/tag/#LoveinPeacehaven. One entry/couple. Capture travel exclusions, stay restrictions and judging from full terms.

records.title: Glenfiddich x Cappello: R10,000 Bogartman voucher
records.findings: 1–31 Oct. Proof of purchase through dedicated site linked by official radio page. Verify complete linked rules, participating bottle/outlet details and age conditions.

records.title: Miway x METRO FM Quote and Ride
records.cost: Qualifying insurance quote and radio mechanics
records.findings: Promoter says 14 Oct–13 Nov; on-air 19 Oct–13 Nov. Two Jetour Dashings plus radio cash mechanics. Station page starts 13 Oct; use promoter dates and explain distinct cash/car entry paths. Insurance sales contact likely; no entry submitted.

records.title: WORLDART10 emerging artist open call
records.cost: PDF portfolio submission; confirm all eligibility/costs
records.findings: Ten artists selected for mentorship and suitable exhibition/promotion opportunities; no cash award claimed. Portfolio PDF by 31 Oct. Do not invent a cash value or suggest generated art is an eligible entry.

records.title: Landscape Alliance #Landscapes4Life photo contest
records.findings: Worldwide submissions 6–31 Oct; public voting 9–30 Nov; USD1,200 total prize pool. Ownership and image licence conditions need clear disclosure; no individual USD1,200 prize claim.

records.title: Tropika Island of Treasure / Engen
records.cost: Two qualifying Tropika products at participating Engen stores
records.findings: 1 Oct–31 Dec. QR/WhatsApp registration; retain till slip, separate purchase for each entry. Monthly product prizes and a Réunion trip for two advertised R70,000. Full travel exclusions/documents must be captured.

records.title: DStv 7 Day Upgrade
records.findings: Pay full/on time for seven days of additional channels, automatic for eligible accounts. Staggered package start dates incl 26 Oct for Starter and Movies & Series; business, quarterly/annual and price-lock exclusions. No free DStv subscription claim.

records.title: Cell C: three months Canva Pro with qualifying 5GB bundle
records.findings: Provider release confirms 11 Aug–31 Oct, R69 bundle with 14-day validity, three months Canva Pro via code. Obtain redemption terms, eligible Canva account rules, payment/renewal/cancellation conditions before publishing.

records.title: TFG Shop.Swipe.Unlock: first Bash-order voucher
records.cost: In-store qualifying purchase followed by minimum-spend Bash order
records.findings: 25 Sep–24 Oct; only customers with no previous Bash purchase. Tiered vouchers from R150 off R500 to R1,500 off R5,000; not free store credit. Link same rewards account; read redemption expiry and exclusions before publication.

records.title: Spotify Premium Standard introductory paid discount
records.cost: R34.99/month for six months, then R69.99/month
records.findings: Current direct SA page advertises paid six-month introduction for people who have never tried Premium. Old indexed three-month R0 campaign ended 23 Sep. Treat as discount with recurring billing, not free trial.

records.title: Vodacom selected-customer Prime Video Mobile Edition reward
records.cost: Invitation-only existing-customer reward; later subscription charges
records.findings: Selected customers notified 2 Mar–15 Nov can redeem 12 months Mobile Edition. Terms say continuing afterwards billed R29/month. Capture cancellation/continuation details; never imply all Vodacom customers qualify.

records.title: Lush samples with online order / in-store consultation
records.cost: Online samples require product purchase; in-store discretion
records.findings: Direct provider fetch confirms up to three samples, availability and exclusions. No sample-only postal dispatch without purchase. Separate online gift-with-purchase from discretionary in-store testing; no guaranteed mail-freebie claim.

records.title: Mambo’s: Suzuki Swift 1.2 GL Auto
records.cost: Spend R750 in one in-store transaction
records.findings: Opens 1 Nov; store closing time 15 Dec. In-store till-slip entry only, online purchases excluded. Direct fetch successful despite browsing error. Do not mark open before 1 Nov.

records.title: OneDayOnly Dealaverse / 5FM and METRO FM, second burst
records.cost: Social comment; confirm current burst cost wording
records.findings: Second burst 26–30 Oct; first closed 2 Oct. Four R5,000 wallet credits across overall campaign/stations. Rules contain broken cross-reference and fee boilerplate; verify live post before release and do not allocate all four prizes to second burst.

records.title: 1UP Mangia pasta: R500 food vouchers
records.cost: Mangia pasta purchase at participating 1UP store
records.findings: Direct current page confirms 23 Oct–9 Nov; ten R500 vouchers, one winner/store. Cached browser extraction shows an older closed campaign; direct provider fetch resolves discrepancy. Keep upcoming until 23 Oct.

records.title: Pattex October–December campaign
records.cost: Purchase required; exact current mechanics unresolved
records.findings: Current direct banner: 1 Oct–31 Dec 2026. Linked rules still 1 Jun–15 Jul 2026 with R116,000 prize pool. Cached browser page additionally shows 2025. Do not transfer old prize details to current banner.

records.title: TechMogul R50,000+ technology package
records.findings: Landing page confirms advertised package/end date but references full giveaway rules without sufficiently defining qualifying spend/products, start, exact contents and verification. Retrieve complete campaign rules before listing.

records.title: Albany Soft Spot Volume Driver
records.findings: Official search result says 19 Oct–18 Dec. Browser and direct host retrieval failed; prize/entry details unverified. Search snippet alone insufficient.

records.title: Absa Moments radio campaign
records.findings: METRO index says over R78,000 cash/vouchers through 6 Nov. Agency campaign terms say 19 Oct–13 Nov. Identify exact station/burst and official linked rules; do not combine channels or prize pools.

records.title: TASTE: two-night Last Word Makanyane safari
records.cost: Account required; full entry conditions hidden
records.findings: Official hub says closes 12 Nov, R74,000 advertised value. Detail page requires login/registration before full competition content. No account created; verify travel exclusions, SA eligibility and full terms before release.

records.title: Whitehouse / Continental Linen October sign-up draw
records.findings: 1–31 Oct, one R1,000 summer hamper stated. Page mixes email signup and generic social notification clauses. Locate actual entry route and mandatory/optional consent requirements.

records.title: Empangeni Mall: Renault Kiger spend-and-win
records.cost: R250 mall purchase; finalists attend in person
records.findings: Terms state Renault Kiger 1.0 Evolution; 20 finalists must attend 19 Dec. Fixed vehicle collection 7 Jan 2027 conflicts with collection within seven days of notification; includes editorial-looking correction. Verify current mall campaign/art and handover conditions.

records.title: Gunret selected KFC stores: R1,000 vouchers
records.cost: R100 qualifying purchase at 15 named outlets
records.findings: Summary says 13 Oct–2 Nov; clause 2.1 closes 23:59 on 1 Nov. Resolve end-date conflict and 20 draw-day schedule before publication; not nationwide KFC promotion.

records.title: Vincent Park Golden Grab
records.findings: Press-release discovery only. Locate official centre campaign rules, operating days/times, qualifying receipts and prize allocation. Do not treat as guaranteed cash reward.

records.title: MTN Summer is Calling / Flip & Win
records.cost: Eligible MTN customer actions not fully verified
records.findings: Partnered article reports 10 Oct–end Jan, R700 million-plus overall rewards. Official campaign rules not located in this pass. Do not list the pool as a cash prize or assume daily/free eligibility.

records.title: DStv Rewards 2026 Big Competitions
records.cost: Paid DStv Rewards membership and continued connection
records.findings: Official rules specify Sept–Nov connection/entry rules but only identify prize as '1 voucher'; no usable denomination or specific campaign. Needs actual current app prize card before a standalone listing.
